main.description: Keeps, on the appview, when the asking account last saw its notifications: those from then on are unread. A time before the one kept leaves it. Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets, from the pages themselves.

seenAt.description: The newest notification seen, by its createdAt.
When it last saw them now, as kept.

description: Says the asking account has seen its notifications up to a time.
